promises.title: Peter's antique brass sand-timer
promises.notes: Peter's pocket sand-timer subtly shivers or tilts toward nearby World-Glass pieces in Books 1-4; revealed in Book 5 as his Hollow Circle seeker dial.

promises.title: Who unlatched the Mistgate side ward for Silas
promises.notes: Silas slips past Glassvale's outer wards in Book 1 with uncanny ease. Monica suspects an inside leak in Book 4; confirmed as Peter in Book 5.

promises.title: The five hidden pieces of the World-Glass
Victor's temptation vs. loyalty
promises.notes: Victor nearly falls for a Shadow shortcut in Book 1 Ch 5; pays off in Book 4 when he finally turns down The Hollow Circle.
